Arjun Kapoor expresses emotional support for sister Anshula's new venture

Actor Arjun Kapoor shared an emotional message for his sister Anshula Kapoor as she embarks on a new journey. He expressed his unwavering support and noted seeing a glimpse of their mother in her. Anshula's childhood was reportedly impacted by her parents' divorce, leading her to blame herself.
